review.management_type_reason: RHS: 花がら摘みと秋の切り戻し。MBG・stauden.de: 花後に花茎を切る。Gaißmayer: 一番花の後に強く切ると秋に返り咲く。Walters の「盛夏に強く切って形を保つ」は初夏の花の後の話で、夏の傷み・倒伏の記述ではないので C にしない
review.management_type_quote: Cut flowering stems back after bloom is completed.
review.heat_muggy_west_evidence:
[おぎはら/品種] 耐暑性；強
[おぎはら 強・欧米 弱] おぎはら自身も楽天のページで蒸れ・暖地の日かげの注意を書いているので、中 にした
[おぎはら楽天/品種] 耐湿性: 普 通 ある程度耐えますが、高温多湿は嫌います（蒸れ 中 相当）
[MBG/種] Plants prefer cool summer climates and do not perform well south of USDA Zone 7.
[食い違い] 欧米の文献（種の記述）は 弱 相当。おぎはら植物園の値を採った
[RHS/品種] Aspect: South-facing or West-facing
review.spread_evidence:
[こぼれ種 1／MBG・種] Plants may be grown from seed, and may escape gardens/naturalize by self-seeding, but are not considered invasive as is the case with some of the knapweeds.
[地下茎 0／MBG・種] Plants may be grown from seed, and may escape gardens/naturalize by self-seeding, but are not considered invasive as is the case with some of the knapweeds.
[地下茎の食い違い] Gaißmayer は 2 相当
review.mixing_evidence: 地下茎 0〜1（こぼれ種・地下茎の根拠の列）
review.silhouette_evidence: [MBG・種] It is a clump-forming perennial that typically grows to 24-30" tall with a spread to 24" wide.
